pages.text: A good first day:$(br)$(li)Punch trees, make tools$(li)Find a village for food and a $(l)Waystone$()$(li)Make a bed before night$(li)Claim your base (see $(l)Your Base$())
Days here are long and sunsets are slow, so take your time.$(br2)If you die, your items wait in a $(l)gravestone$(). Nothing is lost!
pages.title: No Rush
